headline: A 2009 executive order created a new White House Office of Urban Affairs.
what_it_does: This order set up an office inside the White House focused on urban affairs, meaning issues facing cities. No summary was provided, so details about the office's specific duties, staff, or powers are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: White House staff and federal agencies
who_it_affects.how: A new White House office was created to handle urban policy issues, which may involve working with other parts of the federal government.
The office was set up to focus on urban issues, though the material provided does not describe any direct changes to services or rules for residents.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the material provided; executive orders usually take effect when signed, which was February 19, 2009.
